hooks.name: Weekly Release Tracker Reminder
hooks.description: Checks if the current week's AWS security digest exists. If missing, reminds to run @release-tracker.

action.command: YEAR=$(date +%Y) && WEEK=$(date +%V) && FILE="aws-updates/${YEAR}-week-${WEEK}.md" && if [ ! -f "$FILE" ]; then echo "No AWS security digest for week ${WEEK} yet. Run @release-tracker to generate this week's digest and check for stale content."; else echo ""; fi
